    AI Overview
    Pop star Ashlee Simpson Ross was revealed as Galaxy Girl, the winner of The Masked Singer Season 14, in the finale aired on April 1, 2026. She won the Golden Mask trophy after competing against runner-up Phillip Phillips (Pugcasso) and third-place finisher Kylie Cantrall (Cat Witch). 
    Key Details About Galaxy Girl: 
    • Winner: Ashlee Simpson Ross was crowned the Season 14 champion.
    • Finale Performances: She performed "Good 4 U" by Olivia Rodrigo and "Try" by Pink.
    • Clues & Reveal: Her sister, Jessica Simpson, appeared during the finale to present a clue referencing Ashlee’s 2004 album Autobiography.
    • Judge Consensus: The judges (Rita Ora, Jenny McCarthy, Robin Thicke, and Ken Jeong) unanimously guessed it was Ashlee Simpson.
    • Reaction: Simpson described the experience as the "best" of her life and expressed joy at returning to performing. 
     
    Other competitors unmasked in the final stages included Normani (Crane).
